title: Flower-Crowned Skeleton Bride
description: A female skeletal figure with glowing purple eyes stands in a graveyard at dusk, wearing an ornate pale green Victorian dress with lace and dark roses. She holds glowing pink roses in one hand while her skeletal other hand rests at her waist, surrounded by abundant flowers, vines, and a luminous halo of blossoms around her head.
prompt: A beautiful female skeleton with glowing purple eyes and long flowing black hair stands in an overgrown graveyard at twilight. She wears an ornate pale green Victorian gown with lace and dark roses, holding luminous pink roses in her hand. A glowing halo of pink roses, white lilies and purple flowers encircles her head. Vines and flowers grow across her body and dress, dramatic moody sky, fireflies glowing around her, highly detailed digital painting.
